expected_symptom: -M/-MD/-MF produce no dependency file when -P is also given, with no diagnostic and exit 0; the preprocessed output itself should be unaffected.
godbolt_skip: The observable is a set of FILES the driver writes (a .d depfile) and the contents of a -Fi preprocessed output; Compiler Explorer shows only the compiled result of a single translation unit, so it cannot display either. The repro is also multi-file by construction -- a dependency list is only meaningful with #include, and this one uses two nested headers -- and CE is single-file. A link would show a compile that is not the thing under test.
summary: Reproduces, and the mechanism is worse than the report suggests: under -P the -M family writes no depfile AND appends the dependency list to the preprocessed -Fi output, so the .i no longer compiles (E_FAIL, 'unknown type name'). Silent -- exit 0, no diagnostic, though dxc does warn for -Fo under -P. Two causes: DxcContext::Preprocess() never reaches ActOnBlob() where depfiles are written, and DxcCompilerObj::Compile writes the preprocessed text and the dependency rule to the same outStream. Identical on every release from v1.7.2207 (current when filed) to today. Not an enhancement: both flags work independently, only the combination is broken, and it corrupts a requested output.
title: Support -M depfile generation flags during -P preprocess to file
